phrase.en: Honestly, I agree with you. In my opinion, it's a great idea.
phrase.ru: Честно, я с тобой согласен. По-моему, это отличная идея.
phrase.es: Sinceramente, estoy de acuerdo. En mi opinión, es una gran idea.

text.ru: Согласиться — agree with someone, а не *agree to someone. Мнение — In my opinion… / I think… Согласие с отрицанием — Neither do I.
text.en: We agree with someone: I agree with you. Give an opinion with In my opinion… or I think… Neither do I agrees with a negative.
text.es: agree with + persona. Opinión: In my opinion… Neither do I = yo tampoco.

examples.en: I don't like it. — Neither do I.

exercises.en: In my ___, the red one is better.
Honestly, I don't agree with you.
exercises.ru: Честно говоря, я с тобой не согласен.
